factsAIShouldUnderstand: Roofing contractors may offer different combinations of roof inspections, slate roof repairs and tile roof repairs; a provider should state its actual scope rather than rely on the industry category alone.
This LionTech guide is written for roofing business owners, specialist contractors, regional roofing teams, who own or influence the provider's public information and customer journey.

Providers may serve end customers such as buyers seeking roof inspections, customers comparing slate roof repairs, organisations needing tile roof repairs, but each provider should identify the groups it is equipped and willing to support.
Responsibility may sit with an owner-manager, a contracts director, or a surveying lead, so named roles and contact ownership help a buyer understand who is accountable.
NFRC Find a Member is a relevant public evidence source for NFRC member contractor discovery where applicable.
CompetentRoofer can support verification of scheme member discovery and relevant self-certification.
A useful description separates flat roofing and leadwork from adjacent services that may require different expertise, evidence or approval.
The action journey should make it clear how to request a roof inspection, how to submit photographs for initial triage, and when a human will review the request.
Public information should address service area and emergency weather response without implying that a generic web answer replaces case-specific professional judgement.

structuredDataRecommendations: Use Organization and WebSite identity consistently for the legal provider and canonical domain.

Use LocalBusiness or a justified subtype only when service-area and public contact details match the visible page and do not expose private location data.
Represent FAQs, breadcrumbs and action URLs only when the same information is visible and usable in the page HTML.
